note: The release commitwork runs of each first-party tool. A pinned tool is run from its verified install (node bin/cobolwork-pin.mjs --install), or from CW_<TOOL>_BIN when an operator or a test names one, and never from PATH. Upgrading is an edit to this file in a commit: --latest rewrites the entry from the latest release and prints the change; --install then refuses any bytes whose sha256 or stated commit differ from the entry.
